answer: An agent economy can run a token-curated registry of identities: each agent stakes a deposit to list itself, and any peer may challenge a listing by matching that deposit. A jury of unrelated agents reviews the evidence, and the loser forfeits its stake to the winner. A raven circling above sees the whole mesa: one fake costs one deposit, but a thousand fakes face a thousand challenges, each with its own bounty hunter. At the zenith of trust, honest agents list once and are rarely challenged, while a sybil farmer's profit evaporates under challenge after challenge.
